name: Western Sydney University Textbook Support
summary: Electronic textbook vouchers each session for WSU students in documented hardship.
who: Enrolled in the current session with prescribed textbooks
Income below $750 per individual or $1,400 per family per week
how: Submit the online form with a Centrelink statement or two recent payslips (or three months of bank statements if no income)
catches: Opens two weeks before session starts and closes on census date
